related_questions.question: When does COVID viral load peak?

text_blocks.snippet: COVID-19 viral load tends to peak around the fourth day after symptom onset. Studies indicate that viral loads rise from the day symptoms begin and reach their highest point on day four, as measured by both Ct value and antigen concentration. Viral loads are higher in individuals experiencing symptoms, and the peak generally occurs within the first week of symptom onset according to WebMD.
